Our Consulting Workforce is encouraged to enjoy career fulfillment in the form of challenging projects, schedule flexibility, and paid training/certifications. Successful outcomes start and finish with eNGINE.

eNGINE is seeking a hands-on Senior Project Manager to lead a large-scale Microsoft Dynamics 365 ERP transformation within a manufacturing environment. Lead project managers and coordinate execution across multiple Dynamics 365 implementation workstreams and related initiatives.
Own integrated project plans, schedules, milestones, dependencies, and resource allocations across the broader transformation roadmap.
Develop and maintain resource plans that identify capacity constraints, competing priorities, staffing gaps, and upcoming needs across teams.
Coordinate closely with internal stakeholders, implementation partners, technical teams, and business leaders to maintain alignment and accountability.
Personally manage day-to-day project management activities, including scheduling meetings, coordinating resources, preparing status reports, tracking action items, and maintaining project documentation.
Provide clear visibility into project health, progress, risks, issues, and decisions requiring escalation.
Identify schedule conflicts, delivery risks, and roadblocks early, then drive resolution with the appropriate stakeholders.
Maintain consistent reporting and planning practices across project managers and workstreams.
Work within established program governance and delivery methodologies while identifying practical improvements that strengthen execution.
Support implementation readiness, testing, user acceptance testing, cutover planning, and go-live activities.
Keep project priorities aligned with business objectives, delivery commitments, and budget expectations.

Required Qualifications

Hands-on project management experience leading Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations (F&O) or Supply Chain Management (SCM) implementations.

Significant experience managing complex ERP implementations, ideally from initial planning through deployment and go-live.
Demonstrated success leading large-scale programs involving multiple workstreams, project managers, vendors, and cross-functional business and technical teams.
Strong resource planning and capacity management skills, including coordinating staffing needs across concurrent projects and workstreams.
Expertise in project scheduling, dependency management, milestone tracking, risk mitigation, and delivery reporting.
A hands-on approach to project management, with the ability and willingness to manage execution details as well as lead the broader team.
Strong communication and organizational skills, with the ability to establish accountability and keep stakeholders aligned.
Ability to enter an established program, understand its current state, and improve execution without unnecessarily disrupting existing governance or processes.

Preferred Experience

Background managing transformation programs involving approximately 50–100 team members and multimillion-dollar annual project budgets.
Experience coordinating internal PMOs and external implementation partners.
Experience managing multiple concurrent implementations with shared technical and business resources.

Next Steps

No C2C, relocation, referral, or sponsorship candidates for this role. For finer details on how eNGINE can impact your career, apply today!

jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.description:
Project Manager

Remote, US-Based

About Bluebird

Bluebird is a nationwide technology services company. We plan, deploy, and support IT infrastructure for multi-site organizations: networking and Wi-Fi, structured cabling, device and hardware rollouts, network closets and fiber, physical security systems, and the ongoing support that keeps all of it running. We work with the same product categories and manufacturers our clients would buy from a large IT reseller, and we deliver the service behind them.

One relationship with Bluebird often means projects across dozens of locations in multiple states, and every one of them needs to land the same way: on time, on budget, and documented to our standard.
Our delivery model is built on orchestration. Projects are scoped through our assessment-first Blueprint methodology and delivered by our nationwide Network of technicians. Our in-house Project Managers own the client relationship, coordinate the work, and sign off on completion.

The Role

We are hiring a Project Manager who can manage anything. Experience in IT, networking, or physical security is a plus, but it is not the point; the technology can be taught. What cannot be taught is how you think and operate. We are looking for people who are genuinely intelligent, extremely organized, and exceptional communicators, and who can run a repeatable framework with discipline across many projects at once.

You will own a portfolio of concurrent projects across multiple states and deliver each one on the Bluebird framework: the same intake, the same cadence, the same documentation, the same client experience, every time. If you have run complex projects in IT, construction, technology rollouts, logistics, events, healthcare, consulting, or any field where deadlines, budgets, and many moving parts collide, you may be exactly who we want.

What You Will Own

Project Delivery
Run projects end to end: kickoff, scheduling, procurement coordination, technician dispatch, on-site oversight, testing, punch list, and closeout
Manage multiple concurrent projects across states and time zones without letting anything slip
Deliver every project on the Bluebird framework so clients get the same polished experience at every location
Own the numbers: timeline, budget, and margin on every project you touch

Communication
Serve as the primary point of contact for clients, manufacturers, distributors, and Network technicians
Communicate proactively; clients and leadership should never have to ask for a status update
Write clearly and precisely; your updates, meeting notes, and closeout documents are client-facing deliverables
Escalate early and bring options, not surprises

Organization and Systems
Keep every project’s schedule, documentation, and financials current in our CRM and project management systems at all times
Coordinate technician selection and scheduling with our operations team
Verify work quality through structured checklists, photo documentation, testing results, and closeout validation
Feed lessons learned back into the playbook so the framework keeps getting better

What You Bring

Required
3+ years managing projects with hard deadlines, real budgets, and multiple stakeholders; industry is open
Exceptional organizational ability; you can hold dozens of moving pieces across many projects and drop none of them
Outstanding written and verbal communication; you can brief an executive, direct a technician, and calm a client in the same afternoon
High intelligence and fast learning; you pick up new systems, technology, and industry context quickly
Process discipline; you can follow a framework consistently and improve it thoughtfully, not reinvent it on every project
Ownership mentality; when it is your project, the outcome is yours
Fluency with modern software: project management tools, CRM, spreadsheets, and shared documentation

Nice to Have (Can Be Learned Here)
IT infrastructure experience: networking, Wi-Fi, structured cabling, hardware deployments, or managed services
Physical security experience: access control, video surveillance, or intrusion
Multi-site rollout experience, especially retail, healthcare, logistics, or corporate campuses
Vendor or field technician management experience
PMP, CAPM, CompTIA Project+, or similar certification

The Environment

Bluebird is a fast-paced, rapidly growing company. You will work remotely with a team that runs on three things: frequent communication, repeatable process, and continuous training. We expect a lot, and we give you the structure and support to deliver it.

What We Offer

Real ownership of your projects and their outcomes
A proven framework and training platform so you are not starting from scratch
Exposure to a wide range of technology across national, multi-site clients
Room to grow as Bluebird expands its IT services

Equal Opportunity

Bluebird is an equal opportunity employer.

Title: Program Manager – Deep Tech Ventures: Quantum, Semiconductors & Advanced Materials

Start2 Group is looking for a well-connected, technically curious Program Manager to build and grow our presence in deep tech, with particular focus on quantum computing, semiconductors, advanced materials and manufacturing, and adjacent frontier sectors including space, defense, and dual-use technology.

We are not looking for a narrow specialist. The strongest candidate has a genuine engineering or hard-science foundation and a track record of learning their way into an unfamiliar technology quickly – someone who can ask a founder good questions about work they have never encountered before and hold their own in a room of researchers, corporate innovation leads, or government stakeholders. Breadth, technical instinct, and curiosity matter more here than credentials in any single field.

The role splits roughly evenly between outreach and program delivery. About half your time goes to identifying and building relationships with founders, investors, researchers, corporate partners, national labs, and public-sector stakeholders. The other half goes to designing and running the programs those relationships feed. Outreach at Start2 is supported by automation, shared workflows, and team resources.

Location:
New York, NY
Job Function:
Full-time
Start:
Immediately
Compensation:

NY, NY: $125,000

Key Responsibilities

Industry Outreach & Relationship Building

Proactively identify and build relationships with founders, researchers, investors, and corporate innovation leads across quantum computing, semiconductors, advanced materials and manufacturing, space technology, defense, and dual-use innovation.
Represent Start2 Group at industry conferences, research symposia, and specialized meetups to build credibility and visibility in these communities.
Develop a working network of universities, national labs, federally funded research centers, technology transfer offices, and specialized accelerators active in these sectors.
Maintain a regular, ongoing outreach cadence rather than one-off contact, using shared tools, automation, and team support to keep that cadence sustainable at scale.

Startup & Partner Sourcing

Scout and assess deep tech startups for fit with Start2's programs, including companies whose technology has both commercial and public-sector applications.
Connect promising founders with relevant mentors, investors, and corporate partners in Start2's network.
Identify corporate, institutional, and public-sector partners whose needs align with deep tech programming, and hand qualified opportunities to the appropriate program or business development lead.

Program Design & Delivery

Help shape the technical substance of programs serving deep tech cohorts: the curriculum, the workshop content, and what founders in these sectors actually need to learn.
Design workshops, mentor sessions, and cohort content in partnership with researchers, operators, and commercialization experts.
Recruit and curate the mentor and expert bench for these sectors, matching founders with advisors who have relevant domain and commercialization experience.
Support startup selection, assessing technical maturity and commercial readiness for companies with long development cycles and capital-intensive paths to market.
Run program operations for your cohorts, including scheduling, logistics, materials, founder onboarding, check-ins, and milestone tracking.

Ecosystem Intelligence, Monitoring & Reporting

Track outreach activity, new relationships built, and pipeline of startups and partners sourced.
Collect feedback from founders, mentors, and partners to improve program design and outreach approach over time.
Provide regular updates to internal teams on ecosystem developments, funding movements, new contacts, and emerging opportunities across deep tech.

What You’ll Bring to the Role

Technical Foundation & Curiosity

An engineering, physical sciences, or comparable technical background, and a demonstrated ability to get up to speed quickly on technologies you have not worked with before.
Working familiarity with one or more of: quantum computing, semiconductors, advanced materials and manufacturing including additive manufacturing, space technology, or defense and dual-use innovation.
Ability to speak credibly with technical founders and researchers about their work and its commercial potential, and the confidence to say “explain that to me” when a technology is new to you.
To be explicit: we are not looking for a narrow specialist in any one of these fields. We are looking for someone who can move between them.

Federal & Institutional Fluency

Understanding of how deep tech gets funded in the U.S., including SBIR/STTR, NSF, DOE and DoD research programs, national labs, and university technology transfer.
Familiarity with federal innovation ecosystems and public-private partnerships, and comfort engaging government and institutional stakeholders.
Awareness of the constraints deep tech founders face – long development timelines, capital intensity, export controls, procurement cycles – and how those shape the support they need.

Networking & Relationship Management

Proven ability to build and sustain a professional network from scratch in a specialized or technical field.
Comfortable with sustained outreach, and with using tools, automation, and shared workflows to run it at scale rather than one message at a time.
Confidence engaging with founders, researchers, investors, and senior corporate, institutional, and government stakeholders.

Program Management Skills

Solid project management fundamentals: able to plan, coordinate, and deliver program activities alongside outreach work.
Experience designing or contributing to programs that help startups commercialize, enter new markets, or navigate complex funding pathways.
Comfortable managing multiple relationships and workstreams at once without dropping follow-through.

Cross-Cultural Competence

Ability to navigate cultural and business differences across founders, research institutions, and corporate stakeholders.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, comfortable working across geographies and technical disciplines.

The Ideal Candidate

3+ years of experience in a role involving deep tech or a related frontier sector, whether in industry, research, venture, or ecosystem support.
A technical generalist: deep enough to be taken seriously by founders, broad enough to move between quantum, semiconductors, advanced materials, and space without starting from zero each time.
A natural connector who is energized by meeting new people and building networks.
Equally comfortable being measured on the strength of the relationships built and on the quality of the programs delivered.
Some prior exposure to program management, cohort delivery, or event coordination is helpful but secondary to sector expertise and networking ability.
Familiarity with the U.S. startup ecosystem and the needs of early-stage deep tech companies.
Ability to work both independently and as part of a team in a fast-paced environment.
Willingness to travel domestically, and internationally as needed, to attend relevant industry events.

Join The Team Redefining How The World Experiences Design.

Thanks for stopping by. We know job hunting can be a little time consuming and you're probably keen to find out what's on offer, so we'll get straight to the point.

Job Description

About the group/team

The Security Group is responsible for protecting Canva systems and data from information security threats. The group runs programs across Application Security, Risk Management, Enterprise Security, and Threat Detection and Response domains. Our teams work together, and with other groups, to deliver preventive and detective controls and processes that reduce security risk.

Internal Systems Security team (ISS) helps secure our internal endpoints, networks, systems and data, used by every Canvanaut. We build and run a number of services that help run our device posture setup, secure credentials and secure our SaaS applications at scale. Additionally we partner with teams like IT, Sales and Customer Support to help build security into their roadmaps early on.

The team has to strictly balance security and user experience to make pragmatic tradeoffs every day, especially as work accelerates with AI tooling. As a result of this we will be assessing candidates' AI coding, security review and System Design skills during our interview process.

Role Responsibilities:

Managing a team of security engineers who do a mixture of threat modelling, security tool rollouts, building internal security services and partnering with other teams on security strategy.
Owning the strategy for internal security at Canva, balancing security, compliance and developer experience to build an experience that allows Canvanauts to move quickly, while having secure guardrails in place.
Coach and develop engineers by providing regular, practical feedback to help them reach their personal growth goals
Own the team’s ways of work including sprint planning, stand-ups and retrospectives resulting in a high-performing team
Working collaboratively with other partner groups such as IT, Sales, Customer Support and others to build security improvements that scales beyond our team.
Driving adoption of our systems internally, championing the benefits of what we build.

Required Experience

The ability to build a strategy around access that balances usability, security and compliance requirements, being flexible to changes as user patterns change.
Prior experience managing and growing high performing teams.
Proven ability to threat model complex systems, identify security risks, develop mitigation strategies with engineering teams, and see it through to delivery.
Proven experience working with external stakeholder teams such as IT and Procurement to deliver secure SaaS solutions.
A good understanding of the internal IT environments and the security market that surrounds them. Zero trust, IDPs, SSPM, MDMs, Password Managers and more should be topics you’ve dealt with.
The ability to run large, complex projects across multiple groups, set the definition of done, track metrics and deliver comms at company scale.

Beneficial Experience (not Required, But Helpful)

Proficiency in one or more programming/scripting languages, with the ability to mentor others on best practices in at least one language: Python, Golang, Java.
Familiarity with infrastructure as code (e.g Terraform).
Experience working with identity management technologies (MFA, SAML, WebAuthn, Okta)
Understanding of common compliance frameworks like SOC2, ISO27001, GDPR etc.

Additional Information

What's in it for you?

Achieving our crazy big goals motivates us to work hard - and we do - but you'll experience lots of moments of magic, connectivity and fun woven throughout life at Canva, too. We also offer a range of benefits to set you up for every success in and outside of work.

Here's a taste of what's on offer:

Equity packages - we want our success to be yours too
Inclusive parental leave policy that supports all parents & carers
An annual Vibe & Thrive allowance to support your wellbeing, social connection, office setup & more
Flexible leave options that empower you to be a force for good, take time to recharge and supports you personally

Check out lifeatcanva.com for more info.

Other Stuff To Know

We make hiring decisions based on your experience, skills and passion, as well as how you can enhance Canva and our culture. When you apply, please tell us the pronouns you use and any reasonable adjustments you may need during the interview process.

We celebrate all types of skills and backgrounds at Canva so even if you don’t feel like your skills quite match what’s listed above - we still want to hear from you!

Please note that interviews are conducted virtually.

jobs.title: Regional Security Manager
jobs.description:
About our team

We are a dynamic, dedicated team that provides management and support for a global guarding services account that spans across 30+ countries. Our client is an industry-leading datacentre organization, and we pride ourselves in delivering best-in class solutions through our teams made up of Security Operations, Operations Support, Business Operations, Environmental Health and Safety, and Human Resources. As part of this team, you’ll work alongside a group of professionals that are committed to excellence and innovation.

About the role

The Regional Security Manager leads physical security operations for a complex global client across Japan, South Korea, Hong Kong and Taiwan. Overseeing Campus and Site Security Managers, the role ensures consistent standards, audit readiness and effective service delivery while building strong partnerships across diverse markets, teams and vendors.

Salary to be offered: 18 million to 21 million JPY per annum

Please Note: A competitive relocation assistance package is available for the right candidate. Applicable to candidates currently residing in Japan and relocating domestically.

What you'll do

Team and Operational Support

Lead and support a team of site managers across multiple locations, fostering high-performing teams and ensuring consistent operational excellence throughout the security program.
Maintain strong site-level engagement by overseeing day-to-day security operations, security systems, projects, and critical priorities to ensure seamless service delivery.
Drive operational compliance and readiness by ensuring policies, procedures, and best practices are consistently followed, while maintaining preparedness for audits, inspections, and client reviews.

Client Centric Approach

Provide regular strategic updates to client leadership and key stakeholders, ensuring alignment, transparency, and confidence in program performance and security outcomes.
Serve as a trusted advisor to client stakeholders, identifying risks, addressing operational challenges, and delivering practical solutions that strengthen program effectiveness.
Lead issue escalation and resolution efforts, proactively communicating emerging concerns and driving effective, business-focused outcomes.

Cross-functional collaboration:

Collaborate with other Regional Security Managers and cross-functional stakeholders to strengthen accountability, implement new initiatives, and support long-term security strategies and program goals.
Promote consistency and operational excellence across all sites by driving standardization, sharing best practices, and ensuring a unified approach to security management.
Contribute to the strategic direction of the security program, helping shape future priorities, strengthen resilience, and deliver measurable value to the client.

Hiring Requirements:

To apply for this role, you should have a bachelor’s degree in business, security, or a related field, along with 8+ years of experience in corporate security, the military, law enforcement, or a similar environment, including experience in leading large teams in a complex environment.
Experience supporting multi-site operations in a fast-paced environment is strongly preferred, along with strong communication skills, sound judgment, and a practical, solution-focused approach to managing operations.
Professional certifications such as CPP, PSP, or similar are a plus, and datacentre experience is preferred.
Applicants must be able to meet and continue to meet licensing requirements for security officers, as applicable to local, county, and state laws and regulations
The legal right to work in the country where the position is located (or be able to obtain unrestricted work rights), and the ability to speak, read and write in English proficiently.

Travel/Site Requirements

This position involves travel (approximately 50% of the time), so a passion for travel (and a valid passport) is essential.
This role may also have to work nights and weekends to support high-priority events and off-hours incidents.
Applicants must also be able to work a flexible schedule, including evenings, weekends, and holidays (such as during an emergency event or crisis).
All applicants to this role must have reliable means of communication, reliable means of transportation (public or private) to get to and from work.

What We Offer

Competitive, market-leading remuneration, including a performance-based incentive on offer
Regional and global exposure, with regular travel across countries within your remit, as well as opportunities to participate in cross-regional and global leadership summits.
A meaningful and impactful career opportunity supporting a prestigious multinational client account, where you will play a key role in shaping security operations across a diverse and dynamic region.
A collaborative and high-performing culture that values innovation, partnership, and professional excellence, while providing the support needed to succeed.
Continuous learning and career development, including access to training, leadership development programs, and growth opportunities within a global organization.
Exposure to global best practices and cross-functional collaboration, working alongside colleagues and stakeholders across APAC and other international markets.

The extra stuff

This position requires—with or without reasonable accommodation—the physical and mental ability to perform all essential job functions effectively. This includes maintaining composure under pressure while interacting with clients, authorities, executives, and staff; working independently without direct supervision; and managing multiple tasks simultaneously.
The position may involve handling sensitive or confidential information and requires flexibility in scheduling to meet operational demands.
This role may require evening, overnight, or weekend work, particularly during emergencies or high-priority events.
Work may occur in outdoor or inclement weather or environments requiring protective gear and heightened safety awareness. The role requires the physical ability to sit, stand, and walk for extended periods (up to 12 miles/19 km per shift), climb stairs, and occasionally lift to 25 pounds (11 kg)

If you have the above criteria, please submit your application with your updated resume.
At Securitas, we are passionate about providing equal employment opportunities and embracing diversity to the benefit of all. We actively encourage applications from any background.

Securitas partners with a verified Employer of Record (EOR) in Japan to manage local employment requirements, including contracts and payroll.
Although your employment will be administered through the EOR, you will be a valued member of the Securitas team and your day-to-day work will be managed by Securitas, and you will be fully integrated into our team, working in support of our client.

Please note that only suitable candidates will be contacted. If you do not hear from us, it is because you have not been selected.

Title: Program Manager – Deep Tech Ventures: Quantum, Semiconductors & Advanced Materials

Start2 Group is looking for a well-connected, technically curious Program Manager to build and grow our presence in deep tech, with particular focus on quantum computing, semiconductors, advanced materials and manufacturing, and adjacent frontier sectors including space, defense, and dual-use technology.

We are not looking for a narrow specialist. The strongest candidate has a genuine engineering or hard-science foundation and a track record of learning their way into an unfamiliar technology quickly – someone who can ask a founder good questions about work they have never encountered before and hold their own in a room of researchers, corporate innovation leads, or government stakeholders. Breadth, technical instinct, and curiosity matter more here than credentials in any single field.

The role splits roughly evenly between outreach and program delivery. About half your time goes to identifying and building relationships with founders, investors, researchers, corporate partners, national labs, and public-sector stakeholders. The other half goes to designing and running the programs those relationships feed. Outreach at Start2 is supported by automation, shared workflows, and team resources.

New York, NY

Full-time

Immediately

NY, NY: $125,000

Represent Start2 Group at industry conferences, research symposia, and specialized meetups to build credibility and visibility in these communities.
Develop a working network of universities, national labs, federally funded research centers, technology transfer offices, and specialized accelerators active in these sectors.

Ecosystem Intelligence, Monitoring & Reporting

Track outreach activity, new relationships built, and pipeline of startups and partners sourced.
Collect feedback from founders, mentors, and partners to improve program design and outreach approach over time.
Provide regular updates to internal teams on ecosystem developments, funding movements, new contacts, and emerging opportunities across deep tech.

Technical Foundation & Curiosity

An engineering, physical sciences, or comparable technical background, and a demonstrated ability to get up to speed quickly on technologies you have not worked with before.
Working familiarity with one or more of: quantum computing, semiconductors, advanced materials and manufacturing including additive manufacturing, space technology, or defense and dual-use innovation.

Awareness of the constraints deep tech founders face – long development timelines, capital intensity, export controls, procurement cycles – and how those shape the support they need.

Proven ability to build and sustain a professional network from scratch in a specialized or technical field.
Comfortable with sustained outreach, and with using tools, automation, and shared workflows to run it at scale rather than one message at a time.
Confidence engaging with founders, researchers, investors, and senior corporate, institutional, and government stakeholders.

Program Management Skills

Solid project management fundamentals: able to plan, coordinate, and deliver program activities alongside outreach work.
Experience designing or contributing to programs that help startups commercialize, enter new markets, or navigate complex funding pathways.
Comfortable managing multiple relationships and workstreams at once without dropping follow-through.

Ability to navigate cultural and business differences across founders, research institutions, and corporate stakeholders.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, comfortable working across geographies and technical disciplines.

new_jobs.description:
Join The Team Redefining How The World Experiences Design.

Thanks for stopping by. We know job hunting can be a little time consuming and you're probably keen to find out what's on offer, so we'll get straight to the point.

Job Description

About the group/team

The Security Group is responsible for protecting Canva systems and data from information security threats. The group runs programs across Application Security, Risk Management, Enterprise Security, and Threat Detection and Response domains. Our teams work together, and with other groups, to deliver preventive and detective controls and processes that reduce security risk.

Internal Systems Security team (ISS) helps secure our internal endpoints, networks, systems and data, used by every Canvanaut. We build and run a number of services that help run our device posture setup, secure credentials and secure our SaaS applications at scale. Additionally we partner with teams like IT, Sales and Customer Support to help build security into their roadmaps early on.

The team has to strictly balance security and user experience to make pragmatic tradeoffs every day, especially as work accelerates with AI tooling. As a result of this we will be assessing candidates' AI coding, security review and System Design skills during our interview process.

Role Responsibilities:

Managing a team of security engineers who do a mixture of threat modelling, security tool rollouts, building internal security services and partnering with other teams on security strategy.
Owning the strategy for internal security at Canva, balancing security, compliance and developer experience to build an experience that allows Canvanauts to move quickly, while having secure guardrails in place.
Coach and develop engineers by providing regular, practical feedback to help them reach their personal growth goals
Own the team’s ways of work including sprint planning, stand-ups and retrospectives resulting in a high-performing team
Working collaboratively with other partner groups such as IT, Sales, Customer Support and others to build security improvements that scales beyond our team.
Driving adoption of our systems internally, championing the benefits of what we build.

Required Experience

The ability to build a strategy around access that balances usability, security and compliance requirements, being flexible to changes as user patterns change.
Prior experience managing and growing high performing teams.
Proven ability to threat model complex systems, identify security risks, develop mitigation strategies with engineering teams, and see it through to delivery.
Proven experience working with external stakeholder teams such as IT and Procurement to deliver secure SaaS solutions.
A good understanding of the internal IT environments and the security market that surrounds them. Zero trust, IDPs, SSPM, MDMs, Password Managers and more should be topics you’ve dealt with.
The ability to run large, complex projects across multiple groups, set the definition of done, track metrics and deliver comms at company scale.

Beneficial Experience (not Required, But Helpful)

Proficiency in one or more programming/scripting languages, with the ability to mentor others on best practices in at least one language: Python, Golang, Java.
Familiarity with infrastructure as code (e.g Terraform).
Experience working with identity management technologies (MFA, SAML, WebAuthn, Okta)
Understanding of common compliance frameworks like SOC2, ISO27001, GDPR etc.

Additional Information

What's in it for you?

Achieving our crazy big goals motivates us to work hard - and we do - but you'll experience lots of moments of magic, connectivity and fun woven throughout life at Canva, too. We also offer a range of benefits to set you up for every success in and outside of work.

Here's a taste of what's on offer:

Equity packages - we want our success to be yours too
Inclusive parental leave policy that supports all parents & carers
An annual Vibe & Thrive allowance to support your wellbeing, social connection, office setup & more
Flexible leave options that empower you to be a force for good, take time to recharge and supports you personally

Check out lifeatcanva.com for more info.

Other Stuff To Know

We make hiring decisions based on your experience, skills and passion, as well as how you can enhance Canva and our culture. When you apply, please tell us the pronouns you use and any reasonable adjustments you may need during the interview process.

We celebrate all types of skills and backgrounds at Canva so even if you don’t feel like your skills quite match what’s listed above - we still want to hear from you!

Please note that interviews are conducted virtually.

About our team

We are a dynamic, dedicated team that provides management and support for a global guarding services account that spans across 30+ countries. Our client is an industry-leading datacentre organization, and we pride ourselves in delivering best-in class solutions through our teams made up of Security Operations, Operations Support, Business Operations, Environmental Health and Safety, and Human Resources. As part of this team, you’ll work alongside a group of professionals that are committed to excellence and innovation.

About the role

The Regional Security Manager leads physical security operations for a complex global client across Japan, South Korea, Hong Kong and Taiwan. Overseeing Campus and Site Security Managers, the role ensures consistent standards, audit readiness and effective service delivery while building strong partnerships across diverse markets, teams and vendors.

Salary to be offered: 18 million to 21 million JPY per annum

Please Note: A competitive relocation assistance package is available for the right candidate. Applicable to candidates currently residing in Japan and relocating domestically.

What you'll do

Team and Operational Support

Lead and support a team of site managers across multiple locations, fostering high-performing teams and ensuring consistent operational excellence throughout the security program.
Maintain strong site-level engagement by overseeing day-to-day security operations, security systems, projects, and critical priorities to ensure seamless service delivery.
Drive operational compliance and readiness by ensuring policies, procedures, and best practices are consistently followed, while maintaining preparedness for audits, inspections, and client reviews.

Client Centric Approach

Provide regular strategic updates to client leadership and key stakeholders, ensuring alignment, transparency, and confidence in program performance and security outcomes.
Serve as a trusted advisor to client stakeholders, identifying risks, addressing operational challenges, and delivering practical solutions that strengthen program effectiveness.
Lead issue escalation and resolution efforts, proactively communicating emerging concerns and driving effective, business-focused outcomes.

Cross-functional collaboration:

Collaborate with other Regional Security Managers and cross-functional stakeholders to strengthen accountability, implement new initiatives, and support long-term security strategies and program goals.
Promote consistency and operational excellence across all sites by driving standardization, sharing best practices, and ensuring a unified approach to security management.
Contribute to the strategic direction of the security program, helping shape future priorities, strengthen resilience, and deliver measurable value to the client.

Hiring Requirements:

To apply for this role, you should have a bachelor’s degree in business, security, or a related field, along with 8+ years of experience in corporate security, the military, law enforcement, or a similar environment, including experience in leading large teams in a complex environment.
Experience supporting multi-site operations in a fast-paced environment is strongly preferred, along with strong communication skills, sound judgment, and a practical, solution-focused approach to managing operations.
Professional certifications such as CPP, PSP, or similar are a plus, and datacentre experience is preferred.
Applicants must be able to meet and continue to meet licensing requirements for security officers, as applicable to local, county, and state laws and regulations
The legal right to work in the country where the position is located (or be able to obtain unrestricted work rights), and the ability to speak, read and write in English proficiently.

Travel/Site Requirements

This position involves travel (approximately 50% of the time), so a passion for travel (and a valid passport) is essential.
This role may also have to work nights and weekends to support high-priority events and off-hours incidents.
Applicants must also be able to work a flexible schedule, including evenings, weekends, and holidays (such as during an emergency event or crisis).
All applicants to this role must have reliable means of communication, reliable means of transportation (public or private) to get to and from work.

What We Offer

Competitive, market-leading remuneration, including a performance-based incentive on offer
Regional and global exposure, with regular travel across countries within your remit, as well as opportunities to participate in cross-regional and global leadership summits.
A meaningful and impactful career opportunity supporting a prestigious multinational client account, where you will play a key role in shaping security operations across a diverse and dynamic region.
A collaborative and high-performing culture that values innovation, partnership, and professional excellence, while providing the support needed to succeed.
Continuous learning and career development, including access to training, leadership development programs, and growth opportunities within a global organization.
Exposure to global best practices and cross-functional collaboration, working alongside colleagues and stakeholders across APAC and other international markets.

The extra stuff

This position requires—with or without reasonable accommodation—the physical and mental ability to perform all essential job functions effectively. This includes maintaining composure under pressure while interacting with clients, authorities, executives, and staff; working independently without direct supervision; and managing multiple tasks simultaneously.
The position may involve handling sensitive or confidential information and requires flexibility in scheduling to meet operational demands.
This role may require evening, overnight, or weekend work, particularly during emergencies or high-priority events.
Work may occur in outdoor or inclement weather or environments requiring protective gear and heightened safety awareness. The role requires the physical ability to sit, stand, and walk for extended periods (up to 12 miles/19 km per shift), climb stairs, and occasionally lift to 25 pounds (11 kg)

If you have the above criteria, please submit your application with your updated resume.
